strings.name: Scott Farquhar
strings.summary: Scott Farquhar co-founded Atlassian with Mike Cannon-Brookes, developing team software including Jira. He stepped down as co-CEO in 2024 and remained a director, later becoming chair of the Tech Council of Australia and Pledge 1%. He also co-founded Skip Capital.
strings.coverageNote: Reviewed through November 17, 2026. Current directorship and former CEO role, announcements and effective dates, and philanthropic pledges and actual donations are distinguished. Birth retained to year only.
strings.influence.rationale: Co-founded Atlassian, advancing collaboration and software-engineering tools and influencing Australia’s technology startup ecosystem.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education
strings.facts.f1.value: UNSW Bachelor of Science; university records list the class of 2003.
strings.facts.f2.label: Investment firm
strings.facts.f2.value: Co-founded Skip Capital with Kim Jackson; its website lists Jackson as CEO and CIO.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Building team software
strings.highlights.h1.text: With his co-founder and teams, developed products including Jira and brought an Australian software company to international markets.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Corporate philanthropy initiative
strings.highlights.h2.text: Helped found Pledge 1%, encouraging companies to pledge 1% of equity, profit, product or employee time, choosing one or more categories.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Reappointed TCA director
strings.timeline.t1.text: As chair, presents leadership changes at the AGM and is confirmed for another three-year term as director.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Pledge 1% announces chair appointment
strings.timeline.t2.text: The nonprofit announces that co-founder Farquhar will become board chair.
strings.timeline.t3.title: TCA announces chair transition
strings.timeline.t3.text: The council announces he will succeed Robyn Denholm, with the transition scheduled for late March.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Ends tenure as Atlassian co-CEO
strings.timeline.t4.text: Remains a director and special adviser while Cannon-Brookes continues as CEO.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Atlassian lists on Nasdaq
strings.timeline.t5.text: Joins Cannon-Brookes at the opening bell as public trading starts under TEAM.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Pledge 1% initiative launches
strings.timeline.t6.text: The organization’s history dates Atlassian and Salesforce’s invitation to companies to pledge philanthropic resources to Giving Tuesday that year.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Receives UNSW Alumni Award
strings.timeline.t7.text: Honored jointly with Cannon-Brookes for contributions to Australia’s technology industry.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Co-founds Atlassian
strings.timeline.t8.text: Starts in technical support with Cannon-Brookes, then shifts to selling their issue-tracking software Jira.
